name: C++20 Win32 + DirectWrite custom renderer (GDI DIB / Direct2D back-ends) + md4c

variants.notes: best: DirectWrite glyphs -> GDI DIB (no D2D/D3D/GPU driver), first viewport laid out+rendered on a worker thread while the window is created; IME disabled for the UI thread; /O2 /GL /MT
Direct2D device context on a D3D11 WARP (CPU) device + DXGI flip swap chain; device created on a worker thread
classic Direct2D: D3D11 hardware device (default adapter = RTX 5070) + DXGI flip swap chain; device created on a worker thread

RESIDENT (pre-started process, not comparable with cold start): 'fastmd-d2d.exe --forward' hands the path via WM_COPYDATA to a running 'fastmd-d2d.exe --resident' (warm DirectWrite factory/fonts/glyph cache, spare window pre-created and pre-shown DWM-cloaked) and exits; same GDI back-end as cpp-d2d. Separate exe copy (out-resident/) so the resident does not warm the image of the cold variants
